transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brought me in is... lately, after my evening accounting class, I've been stopping for food. And it's not just a quick bite. I end up eating a whole fast-food meal, then I'll get candy from the vending machine, and when I get home, I just keep going with more snacks. It's like I'm trying to make up for not eating the whole day, and I just eat a really large amount all at once.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to prevent weight gain, like making yourself vomit?

Yeah, I have. A few times after those late-night eating spells, I've gone into the bathroom and made myself throw up. I just... I get scared that all that food is going to show on me, so I've done that to try and stop it.
When those eating episodes happen, do you feel unable to stop eating or control what or how much you’re eating?

Yeah, that's pretty much exactly it. Once I start on those snacks, I keep telling myself to just close the bag and go to bed. But... I don't know, my hands just keep reaching for more. I can't seem to stop until I feel embarrassed and just sick of myself.
Are you currently at a body weight that is much lower than what would be expected for your height?
No... no, I wouldn't say that. My weight is pretty normal for my height, actually. If anything, I might be a few pounds over, but I'm definitely not underweight or anything like that.
How often have you been making yourself vomit after these eating episodes?

Well, for about the past three months, I'd say it happens at least one night a week. Usually, it's on a night after my evening class... I'll come home, overeat like that, and then make myself throw up afterward.
